as_told.title: Wall Street Journal: UFO stories as an Air Force hazing ritual

plain: In 2025, The Wall Street Journal, a major American newspaper, ran an article by Joel Schechtman about Pentagon disinformation and UFOs. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says one of the article's claims is that hazing rituals inside the US Air Force, initiation pranks played on new members, explain much of the country's UFO lore. Michels raises it to challenge it, since if true it would mean many UFO stories began as in-house tricks.
